name: Terra State Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Out-of-state (non-resident with surcharge) full-time plateau (12-18 cr) = $4,488/semester (tuition $4,104 + general fee $384) per official tuition & fees page (terra.edu/apply_aid/paying_for_college/tuition_fees, Spring/Summer 2026 rates). Annual = 2 semesters = $8,976. Basis verified: in-state plateau $3,012/sem x 2 = $6,024, matching the known in-state tuition & fees figure.
